description: This Java class handles version checking for the Android SDK, including verifying SDK tools revision against a minimum required version.

classes.name: VersionCheck
classes.description: Handles the version check for the Android SDK, including verifying SDK tools revision.

classes.name: VersionCheck.VersionCheckResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of a version check, including the revision and compatibility status.

methods.name: isCompatibleVersion
methods.description: Checks if the SDK directory or path has a compatible SDK tools revision.

methods.name: checkVersion
methods.description: Reads the SDK tools revision from the source properties file and returns a VersionCheckResult.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the SDK tools revision found during the check.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Determines if a given revision is compatible with the minimum required revision.
